gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-radio-canada: Playful from the first glance, Early GameBoy stretches its letters wide. Radio Canada Big follows in a sans with one round, unswelling outline, so the loud heading gets a quiet partner underneath.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-readex-pro: Widely spaced letters and a skyward x-height make Early GameBoy stand out, with strokes that thicken and thin only slightly. And Readex Pro rolls along below with a steady weight and generous gaps at every terminal, so a long passage moves smoothly.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-roboto: Early GameBoy sprawls wide and brash. Its horizontals run a notch lighter than the uprights, while Roboto is the one that keeps its round letters open and its heights close together.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-ruda: That skyward x-height line and the stretched-out spacing give Early GameBoy its swagger, though its thin strokes barely trail the thick ones. But Ruda draws a wire-like line with no shading at all, so shrinking the heading would leave the two much closer in feel.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-saira: Saira has rounded letters that climb toward the top line, and each s has a gap you can see through. Early GameBoy's wide, lightly shaded heading sits above it and keeps the text flowing.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-sarpanch: Approachable is how Sarpanch comes across, with an e that opens its mouth clearly and a compact gap up to the ascenders. And Early GameBoy, wide and commanding above it, hands over to a body that reads without fuss.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-savate: Savate reads with sturdy hairlines, open jaws on every curve, and a tall rounded o close to the capital. Early GameBoy takes the loud role above it.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-schibsted-gr: Schibsted Grotesk has big, open-looking e and a shapes with tall bowls, and its terminals never close in. And Early GameBoy supplies the swagger, stretched wide with a gentle weight change where its bowls curve.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-sen: Wide, brash and a bit cheeky. Early GameBoy gets its pen-like swell in the bowls, then Sen follows with tall lowercase drawn in one flat fineliner line, so a larger body size would suit it.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-sintony: Loud, stretched and sure of itself, Early GameBoy leads with a skyward x-height and mild thick and thin variation. Sintony backs it with a chunky, tall midzone.
